parameters.query: SELECT id, position, requirements FROM jobs WHERE id = {{ $json.job_id }} LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO candidates
(job_id, name, email, cv_content, match_score, approval_status, ai_evaluation)
VALUES
(
  {{ Number($json.job_id) || 1 }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_name) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_email) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.cv_text) }},
  {{ Number($json.match_score) || 0 }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.status) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_evaluation) }}
);

={{ {
  success: true,
